Compatibility update 0.2.3 targets Endstone 0.11.16, BDS 1.26.65.1 / runtime 26.65 / protocol 2225 and Python 3.11+. The plugin API level remains 0.11.

- Update the minimum supported Endstone SDK and package/runtime version identifiers.
- Run existing regression tests and verify the built wheel's entry points against the real Endstone 0.11.16 bindings before publishing.
- Preserve configuration and player data when replacing the wheel; restart the server after upgrading Endstone.

Support the reviewed 26.65 / Endstone 0.11.16 sound adapter pair, retain protocol 2225 and automatic FFmpeg/ffprobe setup. The Windows candidate passed real server startup, supported-runtime status, first-time converter installation and stereo/spatial pack generation. Retail audible playback is not certified.

See the workflow run for Linux test/build results. Existing feature and acceptance history remains applicable only to the versions originally documented.
